title: The review nests under its round

intent.outcome: A round is drawn with the findings it raised under it, and a round with none says so.
intent.problem: The projection flattens the rounds into an eight-column table and repeats the findings as a flat list, so the link between a round and what it found is lost.

in_scope: the Review section of the projection

acceptance_criteria.description: Round 01 is drawn above the findings it raised.
A round with no findings says so on its own line.
A finding that belongs to no round is still shown.

steps.action: Nest each finding under the round that names it.
steps.done_when: the finding ids appear under their round

steps.action: Draw the rounds as blocks at the pane's width, not a table.
steps.done_when: the Review section reads at forty columns

steps.action: Keep the findings no round names in their own block.
steps.done_when: an orphan finding is still on the page

questions.question: Does a round with no findings get an empty line or no line?
questions.answer: An empty line, so the reader knows the round looked.
